# retrieved chunk

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:retrievedChunk`](gmeow-retrievedChunk.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/retrievedChunk>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A chunk this retrieval returned. Score, rank, and re-ranker attribution ride RDF 1.2 statement annotations on each [`retrievedChunk`](gmeow-retrievedChunk.md) triple ([`gmeow:retrievalScore`](gmeow-retrievalScore.md) + the existing provenance annotations).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RetrievalEvent`](../classes/gmeow-RetrievalEvent.md) -> [`gmeow:Chunk`](../classes/gmeow-Chunk.md)
